sample_unit: patients (668 slides; 10 pathologists read 50 frozen WSIs in reader study)

links.outcome: Pathologist diagnostic accuracy and time with versus without AI heatmap support
links.effect: Accuracy rose from 77% to 85.8% with model heatmap support; diagnosis time fell from 139.7 to 70.5 seconds. Overreliance was not assessed.
links.quote: In the reader study, on average, the pathologists' diagnostic accuracy increased from 77% to 85.8% with the model's heatmap support, whereas the diagnosis time decreased from an average of 139.7 to 70.5 seconds.

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of AI assistance (heatmaps and top patches) on pathologist diagnostic accuracy and review time in a multireader crossover study.

primary.practice: AI heatmap assistance / clinician decision support
